tasks.title: Setup Project Repository
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository with necessary directories and files
tasks.details: Create the project structure with directories for services, infrastructure, and documentation. Initialize Git and set up the README.md with project overview and setup instructions.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify repository structure and presence of README.md

tasks.title: Implement API Gateway
tasks.description: Develop the API Gateway with JWT authentication and rate limiting
tasks.details: Use Fastify with fastify-rate-limit for rate limiting and JWT authentication. Implement routes for service discovery and routing to microservices.
tasks.testStrategy: Run unit tests for authentication and rate limiting, validate routing to services

tasks.title: Implement Auth Service
tasks.description: Create the Auth Service with signup, login, and refresh token endpoints
tasks.details: Implement signup with bcrypt for password hashing, login with JWT token generation, and refresh token endpoint. Ensure proper HTTP status codes for all responses.
tasks.testStrategy: Run unit tests for each endpoint, validate JWT token generation and refresh logic

tasks.title: Implement User Service
tasks.description: Develop the User Service with CRUD operations
tasks.details: Create REST endpoints for user creation, retrieval, update, and deletion. Implement OpenAPI-3 spec for API documentation.
tasks.testStrategy: Run unit tests for CRUD operations, validate OpenAPI spec against endpoints

tasks.title: Implement Orders Service
tasks.description: Develop the Orders Service with create and read operations
tasks.details: Implement POST endpoint for order creation and GET for order retrieval. Use NATS JetStream for async event publishing for order creation.
tasks.testStrategy: Run unit tests for order creation and retrieval, validate event publishing

tasks.title: Set Up Postgres Container
tasks.description: Configure and deploy the Postgres container with pgVector extension
tasks.details: Create Dockerfile for Postgres 16 with pgVector extension. Set up environment variables for database connection and configure volume for data persistence.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify Postgres container runs, validate pgVector extension installation

tasks.title: Implement CI Pipeline
tasks.description: Set up the CI pipeline with GitHub Actions
tasks.details: Create GitHub Actions workflows for linting, unit tests, building multi-arch Docker images, Trivy scanning, and pushing to registry. Implement fail-fast pattern for pipeline stages.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate workflow execution, ensure all stages pass before merging to main

tasks.title: Create Helm Charts
tasks.description: Develop Helm charts for Kubernetes deployment
tasks.details: Create Helm charts for each service and infrastructure components. Use Kustomize overlays for environment-specific configurations.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate Helm chart installation and deployment in dev AKS cluster

tasks.title: Set Up Observability Stack
tasks.description: Configure Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and Tempo for monitoring
tasks.details: Deploy Prometheus for metrics scraping, Grafana for dashboards, Loki for logs, and Tempo for distributed tracing. Set up OpenTelemetry SDK for tracing.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify metrics, logs, and traces are collected and accessible via Grafana

tasks.title: Implement Blue-Green Deployment
tasks.description: Set up blue-green deployment for production environment
tasks.details: Create two AKS deployments for stable and preview environments. Implement routing via a service to switch between deployments.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate deployment switching and traffic routing between stable and preview environments

tasks.title: Implement Automated Database Migrations
tasks.description: Set up database migration tooling with golang-migrate
tasks.details: Create migration scripts using golang-migrate. Set up a job to run migrations as an init-container in Kubernetes deployments.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify migration scripts execute correctly and database schema updates are applied

tasks.title: Implement E2E Testing
tasks.description: Set up Playwright for end-to-end testing
tasks.details: Create Playwright tests for critical flows such as user signup and order creation. Validate interactions between services and the gateway.
tasks.testStrategy: Run Playwright tests and ensure all critical flows are validated

tasks.title: Implement Security Hardening
tasks.description: Enhance security with OWASP headers and Dependabot
tasks.details: Configure HTTP headers for security (e.g., HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options). Set up Dependabot for automatic dependency updates and vulnerability scanning.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate security headers are present and Dependabot is configured for dependency updates

tasks.title: Document and Polish Documentation
tasks.description: Finalize documentation and create a screencast demo
tasks.details: Update README.md and SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md with final documentation. Create a screencast demo to showcase the project setup and features.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify documentation completeness and screencast demo functionality

tasks.title: Finalize and Release v1.0
tasks.description: Prepare for v1.0 release with final checks and documentation
tasks.details: Perform final code reviews, ensure all tests pass, and prepare release notes. Tag the release as v1.0 and publish the blog post.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all requirements are met and release notes are accurate
